issue: The rate-limit reset parser only accepts "reset at <ISO>" and "retry after N seconds". Real Codex 0.160.0 says "Try again at 3:45 PM." or "try again later" (upstream `retry_suffix`/`retry_suffix_after_or`). The repo's own rate-limited fixture ("try again in 60 seconds") is deliberately left unparsed. issue: The fix for R21 (interrupted/shutdown/not_found lanes) also catches lanes that already finished. The "started" set at codex.py:372 is built from every lane identity, including ones marked done. So a lane that completed and is later reported as `shutdown` (for example by a `close_agent` or `wait` call) emits `lane.failed`, and the TUI accepts the change from completed to failed. Confirmed by running it: running → completed → shutdown gives `['tool.completed', 'lane.failed']`. Fix: pass only lanes that are not done (`{lane for (cat, lane), done in self._identities.items() if cat == "lane" and not done}`), make `started_lanes` a required parameter (codex_events.py:205, its only caller always passes it), and add a test for completed-then-shutdown

issue: A single valid Codex record can crash the supervisor, which breaks the "malformed input degrades to `raw.unknown`" rule. Any JSON string holding a lone surrogate escape (a `thread_id`, agent text, error message) passes `CodexDriver.decode` unsanitized. `NormalizedEventWriter.write` then raises `UnicodeEncodeError` at `.encode("utf-8")`. That write sits outside the decoder's `try`, so the error escapes `RawFirstDecoder.feed`. `_stream` then SIGKILLs the child, and `_attempt` re-raises. Confirmed with a one-line repro: `{"type":"item.completed","item":{"id":"m","type":"agent_message","text":"\ud800"}}` gives `UnicodeEncodeError: surrogates not allowed`. The state layer already rejects lone surrogates; the event path does not.
